summary: Fortuna Advisory Group is a West Perth-headquartered multiservice accounting and advisory group founded by Dinesh Aggarwal in 2012, now with 16 offices, listed in the AFR Top 100 Accounting Firms for 2025 and expanding to the East Coast by inviting firms to merge in. Dinesh has spoken about outsourcing as part of a holistic mix of in-house, remote and global staff. He has been emailed twice already (16 and 23 Nov 2026).

hooks.text: East Coast expansion by inviting firms to merge in: onboarding each merged firm's books and keeping reconciliation consistent across 16 offices.
Dinesh's view that outsourcing is part of a holistic in-house/remote/global mix: traceable reconciliation makes offshore work faster to review.
Scale (122 people, 12,000+ clients) with bookkeeping and CFO services means many recurring closes.

risks.text: Dinesh has already received two emails (16 Nov 'Cash coding at Fortuna' and 23 Nov 'Quick chat, Dinesh?'); avoid more than the planned nudges.
Group includes a Managed IT arm and eight service divisions; technology decisions may be centralised or built in-house. LinkedIn headcount (30-40) conflicts with the site's 122.

gaps: No podcast or video content found for the last 12 months; the outsourcing quotes are from a 2023 Xero blog.
No Facebook or Instagram content retrieved.
No dated job ads found (careers page is generic).
Tech stack beyond Xero (via 2023 sponsored content) not confirmed.
